subject.title: Control UI chat markdown only renders data URI images, not remote https image URLs

question: Should Control UI ever render remote `http`/`https` Markdown image URLs directly from chat content, and if so under what trust policy?
rationale: Current source, tests, docs, and merged hardening deliberately prevent remote browser image fetches, while the requested UX improvement would change that security boundary.

options.title: Keep no-remote-fetch default
options.body: Preserve the current default and require same-origin media, local blob/data images, or an explicit proxy/opt-in design before rendering remote images.

options.title: Allow direct remote images
options.body: Accept the privacy/tracking tradeoff and update the renderer, sanitizer attributes, CSP, docs, tests, and real browser proof together.

options.title: Fold into inline media policy
options.body: Let the broader inline-media design decide whether remote Markdown images belong in Control UI at all.

recommendation.title: Keep no-remote-fetch default
recommendation.body: Preserve the current default and require same-origin media, local blob/data images, or an explicit proxy/opt-in design before rendering remote images.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily the Control UI browser-fetch/CSP security policy that drobison00 most directly touched in merged history.
